beats.text: AI is writing more code than ever. So why are software job postings going up?
Indeed's job data shows US software postings rising again since mid-2025.
But look at who they're hiring.
Seventy-one percent of the growth came from senior roles.
And over a third came from jobs with AI in the title.
Meanwhile, total postings are still about a quarter below pre-pandemic levels.
So the market isn't dead. It's picky.
The fastest way in? Show you can build with AI, not just next to it.
